ARCS ui-kit

Kit periodic table

94 parts and 16 templates, laid out by layer, read at five altitudes. A tile's texture is the fidelity its use has earned; n is the number of pages that use it.

Why

Kit parts drift: pages hand-roll shapes the kit already has, and parts sit unused. A table shows which parts have earned their place.

What

Every ui-kit part (atom, molecule, organism, lockup, template) as an element, rendered at the fidelity its use has earned, with a ledger of the events that changed it.

Why now

On 2026-11-13 four molecules were cut from the Louisville proposal into the kit. That is the first event this ledger records by hand.

How

Before: kit_pull.py writes the manifest. During: this page is built from it and the ledger. After: a kit commit is blocked until the page is rebuilt, and session start warns when the ledger lags git.

How to read this: pick an altitude with the bar or keys 1 to 5. Exec is one computed stamp; Surgical is every file. The catalyst ledger sits below every sheet.
